Method of Attack: Improper handling of XML files leading to unintended parsing of external XML files with loaded external entities, potentially exposing sensitive local files.
Impacted Systems: PHP versions 8.0.* before 8.0.30, 8.1.* before 8.1.22, and 8.2.* before 8.2.8
Attack Vector: Shared libxml global state across processes, enabling external entity loading.

Method of Attack: Inadequate length validation during PHAR directory entry reading, leading to stack buffer overflow and potential memory corruption or Remote Code Execution (RCE).
Impacted Systems: PHP versions 8.0.* before 8.0.30, 8.1.* before 8.1.22, and 8.2.* before 8.2.8
Attack Vector: Stack buffer overflow triggered by PHAR file handling.
